itens.desc: Alone since the age of four, survivor of three Special Nights — the last one killed the whole orphanage. He lives on the streets of Brasília and has turned his own fear into method: he watches, he trains, and he only acts when there is no other way out.
itens.power: The Chain — links of blue light that erupt from his right arm and serve as weapon, shield and means of travel. It grows the more he faces it.
itens.flaw: He carries the certainty that every death around him is his fault. The Illuminated has whispered it forever, and Minus almost believes it.

itens.desc: Neither Shadow nor Light. By her own account, she was born by accident in an Illuminated attempt to create something beyond their control. She named herself "Flaw" — then became Nefeli. Invisible to everyone but Minus.
itens.power: Projects a silver screen of smoke carrying information (Shadow counts, warnings). She sees across the ages.
itens.flaw: She spent ages without purpose, only watching. She follows Minus trying to find out why she exists — and what he saw in the second he was touched.

itens.desc: The second marked person Minus meets in ages. She grew up protected — the opposite of the street. She discovers her own power the moment she needs to protect someone.
itens.power: Petals — pink petals that form a shield or attack. She ties it to the memory of roses and thorns: beauty and pain together.
itens.flaw: She calls the forces by other names ("Forces of Darkness", "the Bright Ones") — she sees the same conflict from an angle that doesn't match Minus's.

itens.desc: A canine creature Minus captured inside the Shadow World. Wild at first; four years of training made it an ally. It lacks old Shadow's feelings — Minus gave it a new name because it isn't a friend, it's a living weapon.
itens.power: Consumes other Shadows. Obeys trained protocols without hesitation.
itens.flaw: According to Nefeli, it isn't the original Shadow — it's something shaped. What's left of it when there's no order to follow, no one knows.

itens.desc: It rarely touches a human directly. It watches from a distance and interferes only when it suits it. It treats people as pieces in a conflict too old to have any record — and reserves special hatred for the Marked.
itens.power: Orchestrates the Shadows. Its will scatters or organizes a whole swarm.
itens.flaw: Mrs. Helena called it a guardian angel. She was wrong. The Illuminated protects no one — it coordinates.

itens.desc: A black-and-brown mutt with a torn left ear, who found Minus when he was seven. Neither of them had anyone. It's not one of the shadows — it's just a dog, and it's the first thing Minus chose to take care of.
